fields.Beschreibung: The customer cannot see a clear cost breakdown for reviews or reliably predict and contest assessment modules included in a quotation.
fields.Trigger: Estimating a new certification, change, or annual routine cost before committing budget.
fields.Impact: Cost estimates can change substantially, making budget planning unreliable and leaving the customer unable to influence assessment scope.
fields.Workaround: Ask repeatedly for rationale and either accept the quoted scope or delay the work.

content.title: Submitted changes become outdated during approval

refs.theme: [[Change Assessment Cannot Keep Pace with Internal Change]]

fields.Beschreibung: After submitting a change assessment, companies often wait several months for approval. During this time, business operations continue and new changes to products, processes, documentation, or organizational structures may occur. As a result, the submitted change package may no longer reflect the company's current state by the time approval is received.
fields.Trigger: A change assessment remains under review for an extended period while the company continues to implement additional business, process, or product changes.
fields.Impact:
- Submitted documentation becomes outdated before approval is granted.
- Teams need additional effort to keep documentation aligned with the current state of the organization.
- Implementation of planned changes may be delayed.
- Additional clarification rounds or follow-up submissions may be required.
fields.Workaround: Plan changes earlier and use monthly meetings or an expedited process when timing becomes critical.

quotes.text: Sometimes we submit the changes and there is a lot of time between the submission and the approval. So it's difficult because things in the company continue to move on.
We try to plan as much as possible all the changes, but sometimes it's not possible and we need to use the expedite process.

base.title: Change assessment lags internal change progress

refs.theme: [[Change Assessment Cannot Keep Pace with Internal Change]]

fields.Beschreibung: Internal work continues while a submitted change awaits notified-body approval, so later changes may no longer match the submitted documentation.
fields.Trigger: A change assessment has a long interval between submission and approval.
fields.Impact: Implementation may be postponed, documentation becomes stale, and the company may need to use expedited assessment.
fields.Workaround: Plan changes earlier and use monthly meetings or an expedited process when timing becomes critical.

content.title: Incomplete impact assessment leads to rework and resubmission

refs.theme: [[Change Assessment Cannot Keep Pace with Internal Change]]

fields.Beschreibung: When assessing a change, affected departments, systems, sites, suppliers, or regulatory activities can be overlooked. These gaps are often discovered only after the change package has been submitted or when implementation planning begins, resulting in additional work and delays.
fields.Trigger: A cross-functional change is evaluated without a complete view of all impacted functions, processes, products, sites, or regulatory requirements.
fields.Impact:
- Required assessments are identified too late.
- Submitted documentation must be revised or completed.
- Change packages may need to be resubmitted.
- Planned implementation timelines are delayed.
- Both the customer and the notified body repeat work that could have been avoided.
fields.Workaround: Transfer change coordination to QMS and use monthly meetings to clarify borderline changes before formal submission.

quotes.text: The mistakes happen mostly due to communication. Because sometimes during a project, for example, during a change, some departments are not included.
If we submit documentation and we discover only later that we didn't do an assessment, we need to resubmit again the document. So it's double work for us, for the notified body.

base.title: Incomplete change impact assessment causes resubmission

refs.theme: [[Change Assessment Cannot Keep Pace with Internal Change]]

fields.Beschreibung: Change coordinators can omit affected departments or assessments, and the gap is found only after submission or during implementation planning.
fields.Trigger: A cross-functional change is assessed without all affected departments and activities being included from the start.
fields.Impact: The change must be revised, implementation can be postponed, and the customer and notified body repeat work.
fields.Workaround: Transfer change coordination to QMS and use monthly meetings to clarify borderline changes before formal submission.
